svg.title: Editable ensemble-centered ECD/VCD graphical abstract
svg.desc: Original conceptual vector diagram. All structures and spectra are schematic; no embedded raster images.
svg.text: From conformational ensembles to ECD/VCD interpretation
Quantum-chemical methods • ensemble averaging • stereochemical insight
Sampling + reliable populations govern the averaged spectrum
Representative structures and schematic plots illustrate a general workflow, not a single-molecule dataset.
